Molly Ball Returns to TIME as Washington Bureau Chief

TIME Editor in Chief Sam Jacobs and Executive Editor Alex Altman sent the following memo to staff on Monday: We're thrilled to announce that Molly Ball is rejoining TIME to be Washington Bureau Chief, beginning in January. Molly will anchor our journalism in the nation's capital at one of the most consequential and fascinating moments in U.S. political history. She will write ambitious features, edit and mentor Washington reporters, and shape our political report, …
